collapse_failure_contract.failure_condition: hull reaches zero during collapse pressure

core_loop: begin on HOME under the standard 60-second collapse clock
recover emergency Fuel Cells and Salvage into the field pack
survive the HOME supernova through guaranteed emergency transfer
restore ship POWER, STORAGE, FUEL, NAVIGATION, then COCKPIT
enter abandoned unstable systems and land on their single objective world
recover one Data Fragment plus optional salvage/fuel before collapse
return, store/refuel/upgrade, and choose when to warp
recover six Data Fragments and transmit the archive to Gleebs
game_identity: A complete timed survival/exploration expedition: lose HOME, restore the ship, recover six increasingly legible Data Archive records from hazard- and landmark-distinct abandoned worlds, and deliver the completed archive to Gleebs before collapsing systems erase it.
launcher_policy: source package only; user supplies external Windows launcher

pass16_scope_boundary: One complete fragment-recovery route is implemented. Salvage, fuel spending, repairs, ship upgrades, multi-fragment run progression, failure screens, and the ending remain scheduled for later roadmap passes.
pass17_scope_boundary: Ship resources, four upgrade tracks, a functional hub, optional resource caches, and readable warp cost/range are complete. Collapse failure/restart, hazard variety, six-fragment ending, trading, crafting, and combat progression remain deferred.
pass18_1_scope_boundary: The mandatory first-person ruin transition is removed from active gameplay. Marked ruins are top-down landmarks that award one Relic Core; the Fabricator spends one core for any existing upgrade level, with salvage retained as fallback. No new upgrade tracks, worlds, combat, crafting, or trading were added.
pass18_scope_boundary: Collapse stages, shared pressure HUD, fair paused timers, hull consequences, failure state, and system-entry retry are complete. Planet hazard mechanics, objective variety, six-fragment ending, trading, crafting, and combat progression remain deferred.
pass19_scope_boundary: Backtick pause, universal landing on every intact planet, persistent one-time surface-object recovery, conversion into existing salvage/fuel-cell resources, and focused surface-render/runtime optimizations are complete. No new resource currency, upgrade track, combat system, trade economy, or new world class was added.
pass20_scope_boundary: One visible varied planet per system, all twelve world classes in the cross-system mix, soft exclusion for unavailable planets, and goal-driven autowarp from space/surface/interior are complete. No new currencies, upgrade tracks, combat systems, trade systems, or world classes were added.
pass21_scope_boundary: Sun collision reset, 60-second primary collapse clock, and bounded sunward orbital pixel erosion are complete. No new currency, world class, combat progression, surface hazard rules, or ending content was added.
pass22_scope_boundary: Seamless unbounded top-down surface exploration, bounded procedural terrain streaming, richer geological terrain grammar, and deterministic recoverable resources in explored chunks are complete. The central objective route, one-minute system clock, Relic Core autowarp, existing resources, and all twelve world classes remain unchanged. No new currency, upgrade track, combat progression, trade system, or world class was added.
pass23_scope_boundary: Surface traversal, camera presentation, object silhouettes, interaction prompts, notifications, recovery feedback, and planetfall presentation are polished without changing the seamless world, economy, objective, timer, hazards, or progression.
pass24_scope_boundary: Release hardening, player documentation, itch metadata, clean source packaging, asset validation, and regression verification are complete. No new mechanic, world family, currency, upgrade track, combat system, or campaign ending was added.
pass25_scope_boundary: HOME prologue, guaranteed first-collapse transfer, physical five-step ship recovery, six-Data-Fragment campaign, player-owned departure timing, Gleebs/MatrixCore completion, save migration, and campaign verification are complete. Hazard-specific mechanics, controller-first integration, and Xbox platform work remain later passes.

performance_stability.interior_rendering: authored background retained/reused; Consolas font objects cached by size/weight instead of recreated during every interior frame

performance_stability.planet_caches: LRU item and pixel budgets for material, scaled and atmosphere surfaces
performance_stability.quaternion_transforms: normalized once per frame/path; allocation-free rotation helper for hot loops
performance_stability.solar_rendering: reused alpha layers, precomputed orbit geometry and deterministic stellar definitions
performance_stability.starfield: one-pixel stars batched through PixelArray; allocation-free fast-motion islice LOD; inlined normalized-quaternion projection in the hot loop; reusable cluster layer
performance_stability.surface_rendering: 64-unit deterministic terrain chunks; 48x48 relief samples per chunk; bounded 42-surface LRU-style cache; reusable 640x360 composition layer; bounded 72-region object cache; spatially local harvest scans; inactive-planet chunk caches released
performance_stability.frame_pacing: raw wall time remains authoritative for lifecycle/collapse deadlines; motion/animation delta is capped at 50 ms to prevent hitch-driven camera/physics jumps
performance_stability.presentation_scaling: 1920x1080 direct present at 1:1; exact integer upscales such as 3840x2160 use fast exact scaling; fractional/downscale presentation retains smoothscale
performance_stability.crt_noise: authored 25 Hz noise surface rebuilds only when the 25 Hz noise frame advances instead of regenerating duplicate frames at 60 Hz; static scanline/vignette layers are precomposed after resize so the frame loop uses one static FX blit instead of two
performance_stability.ui_rendering: bounded cached panel fills and text surfaces; cached collapse-pressure edge mask; cached cockpit glow text; cached HUD notice panels
